description: List dated notices in effect on a date (today in Asia/Shanghai unless date is given) for places in China Footnotes, such as holiday traffic controls, temporary closures and special opening hours, each with its sources. Filter by city or place. Only notices the editors have entered are included; this is not a live news feed, and an empty list does not mean nothing has changed.

city.description: Lowercase city id, as listed in cities when search_places is called with no arguments. Omit for all cities.

date.description: Date in Asia/Shanghai, YYYY-MM-DD; default today. Stored notices only; not a live feed.

placeId.description: Only notices for this place id (from search_places).

name: get_current_notices

checkedAt.description: For openEnded notices: day the notice source was last read. null otherwise; see each source's accessedAt.

expiresAt.description: Last day of the stored window. null when openEnded: the source gives no end date.

needsRecheck.description: true: an openEnded notice past reviewBy; it may be out of date and has not been reconfirmed.

openEnded.description: true: the source gives no end or reopening date. Do not infer that it has ended.

reviewBy.description: For openEnded notices: our internal re-check date, not an end date.

startBasis.description: "published": startsAt is the date the notice was published, not a stated first day.

startsAt.description: First day the notice applies (Asia/Shanghai). When startBasis is "published" it is the publication date; the source gave no start date.

sources.description: Source id index. Dates are stored evidence dates, not rendering dates; null means unavailable.

title: Get current notices
